recipes.title: Load neurons from neuPrint
recipes.blurb: Fetch the hemibrain DA1 projection neurons and plot them in 3D. Requires a [neuPrint](https://neuprint.janelia.org) token.
recipes.r:
library(neuprintr)
conn <- neuprint_login(server = "https://neuprint.janelia.org",
                       dataset = "hemibrain:v1.2.1")
da1 <- neuprint_read_neurons("DA1_lPN")   # skeletons in 8nm voxels
nat::plot3d(da1)
recipes.python:
import navis
import navis.interfaces.neuprint as neu
client = neu.Client("https://neuprint.janelia.org", dataset="hemibrain:v1.2.1")
sk = neu.fetch_skeletons(neu.NeuronCriteria(type="DA1_lPN"))
navis.plot3d(sk)

recipes.title: Work with FlyWire neurons
recipes.blurb: Fetch meshes, skeletons and connectivity for a FlyWire cell type from the public release.
recipes.r:
library(fafbseg)
# one-off: flywire_set_token(); download_flywire_release_data()
ids <- coconatfly::cf_ids(flywire = "DA1_lPN")
out <- flywire_partner_summary2(ids, partners = "outputs", threshold = 3)
m <- read_cloudvolume_meshes(ids)
recipes.python:
from fafbseg import flywire
from fafbseg.flywire import NeuronCriteria as NC
flywire.set_default_dataset("public")
m = flywire.get_mesh_neuron(NC(type="DA1_lPN"))
sk = flywire.get_skeletons(NC(type="DA1_lPN"), dataset=783)
cn = flywire.get_connectivity(NC(type="DA1_lPN"))

recipes.title: Compare neurons with NBLAST
recipes.blurb: NBLAST expects neurons in microns - convert units first!
recipes.r:
library(nat.nblast)
dps <- dotprops(da1 * 8 / 1000, k = 5, resample = 1)  # 8nm voxels -> microns
aba <- nblast_allbyall(dps)
hc <- nhclust(scoremat = aba)
plot(hc)
recipes.python:
import navis
dps = navis.make_dotprops(sk.convert_units("um"), k=5, resample=1)
aba = navis.nblast_allbyall(dps)
scores = navis.nblast(dps[:2], dps)   # query vs target

recipes.title: Move neurons between template brains
recipes.blurb: Transform FAFB neurons into hemibrain space. Note that `JRCFIB2018F` is in microns in R but in nanometers in Python (use `JRCFIB2018Fum` for microns).
recipes.r:
library(nat.jrcbrains)
download_saalfeldlab_registrations()   # one-off
x.hb <- xform_brain(x, sample = "FAFB14", reference = "JRCFIB2018F")
recipes.python:
import navis, flybrains
flybrains.download_jrc_transforms()    # one-off, then restart Python
x_hb = navis.xform_brain(x, source="FAFB14", target="JRCFIB2018F")

recipes.title: Compare cell types across connectomes
recipes.blurb: Pull the same cell types from multiple datasets and co-cluster them by connectivity. Requires neuPrint and CAVE tokens.
recipes.r:
library(coconatfly)
ids <- cf_ids("DA1_lPN", datasets = c("hemibrain", "flywire"))
ps <- cf_partner_summary(ids, partners = "outputs", threshold = 5)
cf_cosine_plot(cf_ids("/type:lLN2.+", datasets = c("hemibrain", "flywire")))
recipes.python:
import cocoa as cc
hb = cc.Hemibrain(label="hemibrain").add_neurons(["SLP001", "SLP003"])
fw = cc.FlyWire(label="FlyWire", materialization=783).add_neurons(["SLP001", "SLP003"])
cl = cc.Clustering([hb, fw]).compile()
table = cl.to_table(clusters=cl.extract_homogeneous_clusters())

recipes.title: Query any connectome the same way
recipes.blurb: `connecto` speaks every dataset's dialect so you don't have to.
recipes.python:
import connecto as co
fw = co.FlyWire()       # or co.FlyWire(backend="cave")
hb = co.Hemibrain()
hb.connectivity.edges("DA1_lPN")              # pre, post, weight
skels = fw.skeletons.get(fw.ids("DA1_lPN")[:2])
